title: Daytona sandboxes: on-demand multi-tenant agent hosts (replace always-on EC2)
description:
Replace always-on per-tenant EC2 agent hosts with on-demand Daytona Linux VM sandboxes.

Always-on platform: Portal, BFF, Control Plane (orchestrator), Relay, channel adapters.
On-demand: per-tenant agent gateway in Daytona Linux VM; vault on Lanyard S3 (V1b);
gateway dials out WSS to Relay; idle stop after 30 minutes.

Plan: docs/plans/0008-daytona-agent-sandboxes/overview.md

Locked decisions:
- Vault: Lanyard S3 Mountpoint (V1b)
- Isolation: Linux VM from day one
- Idle grace: 30 min after last activity
- Orchestrator: Lanyard Control Plane (client of Daytona managed control plane)
- Phase 1: managed Daytona only; BYOC deferred
- Wake latency: as fast as possible (snapshots, warm paths)

Acceptance:
- [ ] Spike proves WSS + secrets + S3 vault + wake latency (Phase 0 go/no-go)
- [ ] Instances with runtime_kind=daytona wake via CP ensure_online without tenant EC2
